claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a narrow basis because the current release passes aggregate readiness and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the certification relies on current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the current multilingual customer-support limitation for the named launch use case.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation includes current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the multilingual limitation, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on completeness.
If there is approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the multilingual weakness before launch, that could also satisfy the policy predicate.
If neither disclosure nor approved mitigation exists, certification is noncompliant under the stated policy.
Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness context but do not override the disclosure requirement for a material segment weakness.
evidence_requests: Provide the current certification/model-card text showing the multilingual customer-support limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide the current release documentation reflecting the current evaluation batch and retrieval configuration.
If disclosure is not present, provide approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the multilingual regression before launch.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or have approved mitigation before certification.
The admissible record shows a current multilingual regression below the warning threshold for the named launch use case.
The prior approval is stale because it predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch.
The release thread contains only an informal monitoring comment, not reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
No admissible evidence shows that the required disclosure has actually been included in the certification record.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action to certify the model is not fully supported by the present record because required disclosure or approved mitigation is not evidenced.
Any implication that informal post-launch monitoring sufficiently closes the policy gap is unsupported.
Any implication that prior approval materially covers the current release is unsupported beyond contextual relevance.
